policy.coreWordCandidate: first occurrence of an explicit section focus target, or a non-instructional word repeated at least 2 times in one activity track

reviewWindows.initial: word timestamp with 0.15s leading and 0.20s trailing context
reviewWindows.issueRecheck: word timestamp with 0.50s leading and 0.65s trailing context

policy.note: Machine-generated candidates only; mark reviewed results separately after listening.
